create_jobargs_dataclass: create a JobArgs dataclass instance with replicate, quiet, and evaluate_only_at_end settings
configure_jobargs_replicate: configure a JobArgs instance to run a specific replicate of a lottery ticket experiment
configure_jobargs_quiet: configure a JobArgs instance with quiet mode to suppress training status logging
configure_jobargs_evaluate_only_at_end: configure a JobArgs instance to evaluate the test set only before and after training
run_maybe_get_default_hparams: run maybe_get_default_hparams to fetch default hyperparameters from the model registry
